elements.text: Invoice list with visible filter form, scoped row navigation and comparison results
Invoice detail facts, related navigation and supported action controls
Invoice action review form with exact target/consequence, validation and dismissal
Dense subscription facts, related evidence collection and supported controls
Shared Light/Dark/System preference control with effective theme and host override

items.resolution: Absent records, absent optional values and ineligible review targets use the distinct existing empty/unavailable treatments in Copywriting Contract; an absent preference uses the existing theme fallback, not a new inferred billing state.
items.probe: What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media?

items.resolution: In-flight reads/actions preserve named disabled controls and actual busy feedback until authoritative completion or LiveView readiness; browser online alone does not unlock or replay an action.
items.probe: What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)?

items.resolution: Read/validation/denied/failed/unknown cases expose associated truthful messages and only the supported next step specified in Copywriting Contract; mutation failures never offer blind retry.
items.probe: What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)?

items.resolution: Typical records preserve identity/scope, exact current facts, supported next action and related evidence in the defined scan order.
items.probe: What does the normal populated (happy-path) state look like at a typical volume of content?

items.resolution: Missing fields/evidence remain explicitly unavailable or partial, never zero-filled money or inferred settlement/health; supported action eligibility stays server-owned.
items.probe: What is shown for partial or incomplete data — some fields or rows present, others missing?

items.resolution: At 320 CSS px, intermediate/coarse-pointer layouts and text enlargement/spacing, essential identity/money/state/actions remain reachable with wrapping or labeled local table scroll, visible focus and no ordinary page overflow.
items.probe: What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate?

items.resolution: Zero rows use distinct queue/first-run/filter states, one and many retain associated identity/status/actions and correct singular/plural terms; existing result order and bounded collection behavior are preserved.
items.probe: How does the layout read at zero, one, and many items (singular vs plural copy, spacing)?

items.resolution: Long names, identifiers, diagnostic values and action labels wrap or use existing discoverable disclosure without clipping essential identity/actions, including 200% text enlargement and text-spacing overrides.
items.probe: What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow?
